Adhex Technologies.note: The company was originally named Plasto and became an independent private entity after being acquired by its executives in 2003, later rebranding as Adhex Technologies in 2015.

Bilcare Limited.note: Bilcare Limited remains an independent publicly traded firm on the BSE, though it divested its global films business to its subsidiary Bilcare AG and its pharma packaging division to Caprihans India.

Covestro Deutschland AG.note: XRG P.J.S.C. completed the acquisition of Covestro in December 2025 and subsequently initiated a corporate squeeze-out of minority shareholders in 2026.

ISO Poly Films, Inc..note: Sigma Plastics Group acquired ISO Poly Films from private equity firms Azalea Capital and Capitala Group in February 2009.

MEDIPACK AG.note: MEDIPACK AG operates as an independent, family-owned system supplier for medical packaging founded by the Artusi family.

Plastica Sp. z o.o..note: Plastica Sp. z o.o. was established in 2003 as a newly founded member company of the TZMO Group.

SÜDPACK Verpackungen SE & Co. KG.note: In January 2026, SÜDPACK sold its US operations to PPC Flexible Packaging, but the German parent company remains independent.

Excel Scientific, Inc..note: Vance Street Capital LLC acquired Excel Scientific, Inc. in 2021.
